_comment: Untranslated mapping data for server/scripts/localise-seals.mjs, the one-off migration that replaced the catalogue's Chinese chop characters with English labels. Kept as data rather than code so the migration script itself contains no non-Latin text and passes the language audit.
note: The character for 'aged' was used by two different products; the second occurrence was given the label 'Vintage' by hand after the migration ran.
